name: Far-Off Friends
source:
Your father passed away recently due to a long fight against cancer and you never knew about your mother.
During his will reading, you got even more confused, due to the will having more heirs than you were expecting.
You finished the school recently and you were ready to enjoy a sabbatical year,
with your best friend before going to the college.
Your plan was "heal" your mind from the suffering that your father had,
but you got curious over the conditions of the will and decided to make a travel to see who are the other heirs.
But you weren't expecting to arrive in a such good place. A place where you finally can call "home".​
